name: Anti-Aging Cleanser with Peptides
descriptor: A fresh start. A softer feel.
description: A peptide-enriched facial cleanser with glycerin and panthenol. Cleanses away daily buildup while helping skin feel comfortable.
directions: Massage a small amount onto damp skin, then rinse thoroughly. Use morning and evening.

name: Hydrating Tonic
descriptor: A little hydration. Before everything else.
description: An aloe-based tonic with glycerin and sodium PCA. A light hydration step after cleansing, before your chosen serum.
directions: Sweep over the face and neck with a cotton pad after cleansing. Use morning and evening.

name: Exfoliating Pads
description: Pre-moistened pads with mandelic, lactic and salicylic acids. A focused exfoliating step for uneven texture and congested-looking skin.
directions: Sweep a pad over the areas you want to exfoliate, avoiding eyes. Follow the product label for frequency. Use sunscreen and limit sun exposure during use and for a week afterwards.

name: Hydra C + Ferulic Serum
description: A vitamin C and ferulic acid serum with sodium hyaluronate. Designed to bring antioxidant care and hydration to a routine for dull or uneven-looking skin.
ingredients: Vitamin C, ferulic acid and sodium hyaluronate
directions: Apply a small amount to the face and neck after cleansing and toning. Follow with moisturizer and daytime SPF. May be used morning and evening.

name: Retinol Rx
descriptor: An evening ritual. A renewed look.
description: An encapsulated retinol serum with niacinamide and squalane. An evening treatment for the appearance of fine lines and uneven texture.
directions: Use in the evening, introducing gradually as tolerated and following the product label. Wear SPF 30 or higher during the day. Do not use when pregnant or breastfeeding.

name: Firming Peptide Eye Gel
description: A cooling peptide eye gel with aloe and cucumber water. A light, targeted step for smoother-looking skin around the eyes.
directions: Gently apply a small amount around the eye area after cleansing, avoiding direct contact with eyes. Use morning and evening.

name: Copper Peptide Restore Cream
description: A rich multi-peptide moisturizer with copper peptide, shea butter and sodium hyaluronate. Delivers moisture for dry-feeling skin and a smoother, firmer-looking finish.
ingredients: Copper peptide, shea butter and sodium hyaluronate
directions: Apply to face and neck after cleansing and serum. Follow with SPF in the morning. Contains retinol; consider your other active products when building a routine.
